.github/workflows/sync-data.yml.description: Staging vs Production Workflow Differences: (1) Checkout refs - staging uses 'staging' branch HEAD, production uses latest release tag; (2) Schedules - staging at 6 AM UTC, production at 7 AM UTC; (3) Production-only steps - release tag fetch, smoke tests with SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; (4) Cache isolation via environment-specific keys; (5) Both environments use same secret names but different values. Critical insight: identical failure in both environments indicates shared external dependency issue (Parliament API) not configuration difference.
